answer.question: Which interventions make up the SEP-1 numerator, and which patients are excluded?
answer.answer: The SEP-1 numerator includes patients who receive all applicable parts of the bundle: an initial lactate measurement, blood cultures, antibiotics, fluid resuscitation, a repeat lactate measurement, vasopressors, and reassessment of volume status and tissue perfusion. Exclusions include patients without severe sepsis, those transferred from another acute care facility, and those who received intravenous antibiotics for more than 24 hours before severe sepsis presented.
